messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":7,"verses":[{"chapter":7,"verse":21,"text":"21 And the eagle said: “I say to you, Jeremiah, come, untie this letter and read it to the people.” So he untied the letter and read it to the people."},{"chapter":7,"verse":22,"text":"22 And when the people heard it, they wept and put dust on their heads, and they said to Jeremiah: “Rescue us and tell us what to do so that we may once again enter our city.”"},{"chapter":7,"verse":23,"text":"23 And Jeremiah answered and said to them: “Do whatever you heard from the letter, and the Lord will lead us into our city.”"},{"chapter":7,"verse":24,"text":"24 And Jeremiah wrote a letter to Baruch, saying: “My beloved son, keep praying diligently and begging God on our behalf, so that he might direct our way until we come out of the jurisdiction of this lawless king."},{"chapter":7,"verse":25,"text":"25 For you have been found righteous before God, and he did not let you come here, so that you would not see the affliction which has come upon the people at the hands of the Babylonians."}],"book_code":"4BAR"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 21,22,23,24,25 in this chapter.
